mentions.name: Calens
mentions.description: Calens is a Google Calendar time-analytics tool that shows a GitHub-style heatmap of 52 weeks of calendar activity, weekly and monthly time breakdowns by calendar or tag, a progress chart of planned vs completed time, and an in-page event editor. Everything runs on-device in the browser with no servers or tracking.
mentions.problem: Calendar users can't easily answer where their time actually went each week; Google Workspace Time Insights is locked to paid accounts and doesn't work for personal Google Calendar.
mentions.audience: Looking for people who already log their life in Google Calendar and want better data on their habits.
mentions.source_excerpt: Calens fills that gap: GitHub-style heatmap showing 52 weeks of calendar activity, weekly/monthly time breakdowns by calendar or tag, a progress chart of planned vs completed time, and a cleaner in-page event editor. Everything runs on-device — no servers, no tracking, no data leaving the browser.
